selection_basis: Brand pronunciation selected under the user's authorization to proceed with the recommended pronunciation; not an empirical claim about spontaneous English readings.

hey_vosen.medial_consonant_target: s; z is not an additional positive target

transcription_equivalence.scope: Notation equivalence only when e represents the DRESS/head vowel, as in Cambridge's transcription; not a blanket acoustic or token substitution.
transcription_equivalence.does_not_imply: Acceptance of eɪ, æ, ɪ or iː as additional first-vowel targets, or replacement of final oʊ with ɔ, ʌ or ə.

future_variants.description: British-style GOAT vowel əʊ in the final syllable.

excluded_positive_pronunciations.scope: Do not mix the MEER-oh family into this profile's primary positive class; exclusion from positives is not automatic assignment as a strict negative.

collision_policy.handling: Keep phonetic collisions or unresolved name pronunciations separate from strict negatives; inspect actual audio rather than infer separation from spelling.

examples.basis: Cambridge lists US marrow as ˈmer.oʊ; the selected Mero target can be homophonous.
Potential name/spelling collision; no universal pronunciation for this name is asserted.
Cambridge lists both hay and hey as heɪ, in addition to the US marrow overlap.

collision_policy.limitation: An acoustic-only model cannot reliably distinguish identical pronunciations solely by their intended spellings.

historical_probe_policy.interpretation: Retain earlier outcomes under their original contracts. Failure of a marrow-æ control does not establish an unnatural pronunciation. Prior recognizer outputs do not redefine this profile.

scope.current: Primary US-oriented English pronunciation contract and fresh model-quality work.
scope.evidence_limit: No spontaneous-user pronunciation frequency, human-validated naturalness, or model-quality improvement is claimed.
scope.implementation_boundary: Declarative pronunciation guidance only; admission rules and synthesis details are defined separately. Text spelling equivalences do not authorize additional acoustic positive variants.

sources.supports: US ˈmer.oʊ; e is illustrated by head; UK ˈmær.əʊ.
